Welcome to Naked Wardrobe. I’m here to help you find the perfect fit or answer any questions.
What is your return policy?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
NAKED WARDROBE’s return policy states:



YOU HAVE 14 DAYS AFTER RECEIVING YOUR ITEM TO REQUEST A RETURN.


TO BE ELIGIBLE, THE ITEM MUST BE IN THE SAME CONDITION YOU RECEIVED IT: UNWORN OR UNUSED, WITH TAGS, AND IN ITS ORIGINAL PACKAGING.


YOU’LL ALSO NEED THE RECEIPT OR PROOF OF PURCHASE.


RETURNS THAT HAVE BEEN TRIED ON MUST BE SENT BACK WITHOUT MAKEUP, SELF-TANNER, DEODORANT, PET HAIR, OR OTHER STAINS.


ITEMS RETURNED WITH STAINS AND/OR FINAL SALE ITEMS WILL BE PROCESSED FOR STORE CREDIT.


YOU MUST PROVIDE A VALID EMAIL ADDRESS AT CHECKOUT IN ORDER TO LOCATE YOUR ORDER NUMBER.



If you want, I can also help with how to start a return.
How many days do I have to return something?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
You have 14 DAYS AFTER RECEIVING YOUR ITEM to return it. To start the return, use the return portal here: https://nakedwardrobe.com/apps/aftership-returns-center
How do I start a return or an exchange?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
Start your return or exchange through our return portal: https://nakedwardrobe.com/apps/aftership-returns-center
For a size or color exchange, enter your NW ORDER NUMBER exactly as shown in your order confirmation email, select the return reason "ITEM DID NOT FIT," then choose "REPLACE WITH SAME ITEM" to pick a new size or color. If the option you want doesn’t appear, that item is currently out of stock.
Do I have to pay for return shipping?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
A $9.99 RESTOCKING FEE is deducted from each refund for processing and restocking. To start a return or exchange, please use the return portal: https://nakedwardrobe.com/apps/aftership-returns-center
